title: tridophyllum bienne
intro: Tridophyllum bienne, commonly known as American valerian, is a flowering plant native to North America. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and insomnia, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Tridophyllum bienne include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of the plant include valerenic acid, valerenol, and valepotriates, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
